acceptanceCriteria: The table is generated from at least 3 hosted runs.
C1 placement keeps the max-slice prediction within 20% of observed.
Invalid or missing data falls back to a single slice.
body: Found 2026-10-10 by the CI audit (report /private/tmp/claude-501/gotmp/ci-audit.md; 60 ci.yml runs; main run 38055182050). PR wall median 39.8 min, critical path always go-product-shard 0. Extract bounded per-top-level-test elapsed times from retained shard -json streams (AFP-V0-040 artifacts) into an advisory table consumed by C1 test-level splitting. Same advisory-only, never-membership rule as package costs.
title: cishards: per-test cost table from go test -json for sub-package placement
